concept.title: The agent list
concept.shortdesc: Where the page shows a list instead of the hierarchy (a workspace on the stable channel until its stable release has the hierarchy), each agent card shows:

ul.li: Its provider badge (which AI vendor/CLI runs it).
Its write mode badge — proposal (orange) or direct (red).
📁 if the agent has repository access.

conbody.p: Sync from disk re-reads agent definition files from the server's data directory — agents are stored as plain markdown files with YAML frontmatter, so they can also be edited outside the app and synced in.
